reason.description: Why, for every status but awaiting-approval, in 1-2 sentences. Posted for CD: plain language per ops/sdlc/process/writing-for-cd.md.

deliverable.description: The deliverable ID the factory reserved (Dnn)

document.description: Path of the plan or spec written, under docs/; empty when none

title.description: PR title without the ID, at most 72 characters; empty when no document

brief.description: The PR description, one field per section of ops/sdlc/templates/pr_description_template.md (plan variant). Plain sentences, no markdown except backticks around a path or code name; about 450 words in all. Empty fields when stopping without a PR

problem.description: The problem: what prompted this and the symptom a user sees, in 2-3 plain sentences

user_changes.description: Each change a user will see, in their terms; empty when nothing is visible

decisions.description: What CD approves: each decision with the alternative it rejects and why; scope beyond the issue is a decision that says so

choice.description: The decision, as a short sentence

rejected.description: The alternative not taken and why, written to follow the words Rather than

scope.description: What is tackled, what is not (non-goals), and follow-ups proposed as issues

risk.description: Tier by the template risk table (empty only when stopping early), why, the top risks, and how to undo

review_focus.description: Where the author is least sure, and what CD may not have thought of

verification.description: How it will be verified: the tests and checks that will run, and what CD will be able to see

how_it_works.description: The approach at a high level, how the pieces fit, and why it is shaped this way when not obvious

files.description: Key files in reading order, each with its role in this change

path.description: Repository path, read before naming it

concepts.description: 0-3 terms CD may not know, each with a plain definition

parts.description: split only: the parts in execution order, exactly as the parts table of the split record lists them; empty for every other status

part.description: The ID of the parent plus a letter, in order (D34a, D34b, ...)

depends_on.description: Earlier parts or other deliverables that must be Complete first

spec.description: A full-tier part that reuses an approved spec: its docs/current_work/specs/ path; empty otherwise

scope.description: What this part delivers, one or two plain sentences

questions.description: 1-3 entries when status is needs-input, empty otherwise. A question is the decision, why it matters, and each option with its consequence in one line, recommended first. A discovery check-in is one entry of about 300 words. Posted for CD: plain language per ops/sdlc/process/writing-for-cd.md.

findings.description: Open review findings: critical/major when escalated, open minors otherwise

location.description: Where: a file and line, or a document section

summary.description: One line: what is wrong and why it matters. Posted for CD: plain language per ops/sdlc/process/writing-for-cd.md.

deferred.description: Questions and follow-ups that did not block the run, one line each with its options. Posted for CD: plain language per ops/sdlc/process/writing-for-cd.md.

notes.description: What a restart needs: what was researched and decided so far (posted as the issues discovery notes). For the next run, not for CD: keep the detail here, not in questions

outbound.description: Skipped actions outside the working tree, for CD: one line each, what to do and where. Posted for CD: plain language per ops/sdlc/process/writing-for-cd.md.

facts.description: FACTS scores: the mean and the lowest phase; empty when not scored
